name: stage150-rust-daemon-lifecycle-smoke-gate
gate_decision: stage150 admits only an opt-in Rust daemon lifecycle file-protocol smoke under temporary paths: pid/progress/sdnotify/log writes and reload/suspend progress bytes are validated, but Rust default run entrypoint, control-plane ownership, matched benchmark, default switch, and product switch remain closed

rows.evidence: Stage150 writes pid, progress, sdnotify, and log files under /tmp/dae-stage150* only
rows.boundary: the smoke does not touch /var/run/dae.pid or /var/run/dae.progress
rows.next_action: keep isolated paths mandatory for future lifecycle and benchmark stages

rows.evidence: startup uses ReloadDone, reload uses ReloadSend/ReloadProcessing/ReloadDone, and suspend uses ReloadProcessing/ReloadDone
rows.boundary: progress bytes do not prove production signal handling or listener reuse
rows.next_action: add opt-in control-plane owner and signal smoke before benchmark

rows.evidence: Go default path is preserved and product switches remain false
rows.boundary: lifecycle file smoke is not true default daemon admission
rows.next_action: run control-plane lifecycle and matched benchmark before reconsidering default switch

validation_commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-daemon --bin dae-daemon-optin -- stage150-lifecycle-smoke --root /tmp/dae-stage150-daemon-lifecycle-smoke
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-cli --bin dae-cli-optin --quiet -- runtime stage150-rust-daemon-lifecycle-smoke-gate
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-cli --bin dae-cli-optin --quiet -- runtime stage150-rust-daemon-lifecycle-smoke-gate --execute-smoke --root /tmp/dae-stage150-cli-lifecycle-smoke
cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-daemon -p dae-cli -p dae-product -q
cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-outbound -p dae-cli -p dae-product -q
remaining_blockers: Rust default run entrypoint and control-plane ownership are not admitted
Stage150 lifecycle smoke does not start production tproxy/eBPF/control-plane traffic
matched benchmark cannot execute until control-plane lifecycle and traffic smoke pass
default daemon and product-chain switches remain closed
